modification_reason: Disable non-essential language frontends; migrated to gorget source-pipeline.yaml (HUM-5620): all four sources (gcc, nvptx-tools, newlib-cygwin, isl) now fetched by the pipeline instead of update-gcc.sh/manual recipes, with changelog/PR extraction replicated by rpms/gcc/gorget-update-changelog.sh's post: step. upstream_repo points at gcc.gnu.org's read-only mirror on googlesource.com instead of gcc.gnu.org itself (HUM-4621 gcc incident, HUM-6309): gcc.gnu.org's git server aggressively rate-limits clone/fetch operations (confirmed repeatedly, including from a residential VPN), while gnu.googlesource.com -- Google's official read-only mirror of all GNU project repos -- serves the same content reliably and is content-addressed identically (same commit SHAs). This field feeds both gorget's own ${UPSTREAM_REPO} fetch and dist_git.py update's fixed-ref pin-refresh logic, so both benefit.
